waypoints.name: White Salmon Lodge road gate (Mount Baker Highway hairpin)
waypoints.directions: From Glacier, drive the Mount Baker Highway (SR-542) east about 18 miles to the hairpin switchback at roughly 3,500 ft, below the ski area, and park in the small pull-off at the gated White Salmon Road (FS 3075). Parking is very limited and is not allowed on the highway shoulder; do not block the gate. No parking pass is required.

waypoints.name: White Salmon Glacier toe
waypoints.note: Glacier travel begins where the road/approach ends.

waypoints.name: Winnie's Slide
waypoints.note: 150-200 ft step of steep 40-45° snow/ice onto the Upper Curtis Glacier; schrund can be tricky late season.

waypoints.name: Hell's Highway
waypoints.note: Snow chute connecting to the west edge of the Sulphide Glacier.
